correctness.rationale: Specializing Carrel–Vandereycken Eq (31) to scalar drift -aI and constant PSD forcing C gives W=sY+q(PC+CP-PCP), with s=exp(-2ah), q=(1-s)/(2a) or h for a=0, and t=q/s. For rank-one Y=sigma uu^T, the only nonzero block of W/s is [[sigma+tc,t||w||],[t||w||,0]], whose positive eigenvalue has strictly larger magnitude than any negative eigenvalue, so every best rank-one Frobenius/SVD truncation is uniquely PSD. For Y=diag(d,e,0), C=(1,0,1)(1,0,1)^T, R=W/s has spectrum p(t)>0,e>0,-b(t), b=[sqrt((d+t)^2+4t^2)-(d+t)]/2. The SVD rank-two selection flips to the negative eigenmode when b>e, equivalently t^2>e(d+t+e), with unique t_*=(e+sqrt(4de+5e^2))/2. h_* follows by inverting t(h). At equality both PSD and indefinite optimal truncations are possible. Higher-rank embedding discards a smaller positive e, retains negative -b, and minimum dimension/rank are 3/2. PSD-constrained best approximation residual s*b versus unrestricted s*e, unbounded b/e as e to zero; exact flow sY+qC remains PSD. Independent SymPy characteristic polynomial, threshold relation and exact witness eigenvalues (1+sqrt2,1/10,1-sqrt2) verify critical arithmetic; not a proof substitute.
residual_risks: Only exact projected exponential Euler for constant PSD forcing, scalar stable drift, symmetric matrices; SVD truncation is set-valued at ties; no arbitrary matrix drift or long-time guarantee.

originality.rationale: Carrel–Vandereycken introduced the exact tangent-projected exponential Euler and Eq (31); the algorithm is unequivocally prior. Other Lyapunov solvers (Kressner et al.) were already known to yield indefinite approximants and need positive-part repair; this generic phenomenon is not new. The assessed contribution is the specific method-wide rank-one safety theorem, rank-two minimal counterexample, exact step boundary including tie and damping, and unbounded constrained repair cost. The primary original method paper does not state those facts. Risk remains that an older generic best-rank PSD perturbation theorem subsumes these exact formulas.
